scripts.app:dev: npm run payload:clean && npm run payload:prepare && npm run dev
scripts.app:dev:win: npm run payload:clean && npm run payload:prepare:win && npm run dev
scripts.app:dev:mac: npm run payload:clean && npm run payload:prepare:mac && npm run dev
scripts.app:build: npm run payload:clean && npm run payload:prepare && npm run build
scripts.app:build:win: npm run payload:clean && npm run payload:prepare:win && npm run build
scripts.app:build:mac-arm64: npm run payload:clean && npm run payload:prepare:mac-arm64 && npm run build -- --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.app:build:mac-x64: npm run payload:clean && npm run payload:prepare:mac-x64 && npm run build -- --target x86_64-apple-darwin
